items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM in weekend injury summary then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders.
items.why: ETR weekend summary GTD optimism; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed active despite calf.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected; no major snap loss.
items.opportunity: High target/route share intact with Adams IR context.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then inactive; unlikely to play on return from quad.
items.why: ETR pess GTD; Rapoport sources unlikely, Schefter listed inactive.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snap/carry spike for Jets.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle twist on purposeful slide; pain went away quickly, Campbell 'should be good'.
items.why: Levitan: almost certainly fine; post-game player/coach confirms pain gone.
items.opportunity: Continued  high carry+target share; Lions offense humming.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then active; post-game hamstring 'came out great', back not expected to sideline.
items.why: ETR expected; Schefter active + player comments fine; Rapoport active.
items.implication: Continued heavy RB1 usage despite hobble.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT (high ankle); still pain on cuts/sprints, chance Week 8 depending practice.
items.why: ETR OUT list; ongoing ankle symptoms.
items.implication: Huntley continues; Flowers etc. capped until return.
items.opportunity: Backup QB volume; Zay Flowers YPRR still elite.

items.implication: PHI WR corps thinned; slot/others elevated targets.
Further thins Eagles WR depth for MNF and beyond.
items.opportunity: Beneficiary target share for other PHI pass-catchers.

items.why: ETR IN list; Rapoport return notes.
items.implication: Reclaims lead back role for Packers.

items.text: When we talk about workhorse running backs, we are NOT talking about Bucky Irving enough.
Josh Jacobs is BACK. Discuss fantasy value going forward/ROS.
items.why: Return + ROS value talk on Pregame.

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?
Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner efficiency (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Data: volume/HVT overrides efficiency; backup better YPC in scheme.
items.implication: Sustainable floor via targets/GL work despite poor running.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 + target monopoly; RB1 upside if efficiency rebounds.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead; Tank Dell only 6 in return; Noel 15 (turf toe exit).
items.why: Clear route lead post-Dell limited return.
items.implication: Nico alpha locked; Dell slow ramp.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (of 36 Mahomes DB) without Rice; career never >83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.why: Volume spike but historical ceiling low.
items.implication: High floor volume, limited upside without efficiency jump.
items.opportunity: Route monopoly temporary; monitor Rice return.
items.conflict: High routes vs low historical ceiling.
